snippet.title: Spirit Crossing – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Spirit Crossing launches on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch November 16, 2026! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/spirit-crossing-switch-2/?utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_source=SW

In this whimsical life-sim MMO from the makers of Cozy Grove, build a home, help spirits, and cross paths with other players, all on your own terms. Customize your look with hairstyles, dyes, and mix-and-match outfits, then bring it all to life with dozens of expressive emotes! Welcome to your strange new home in the Crosslands.

#IndieWorld #SpiritCrossing

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
